questions.text: College Shop Now is the time to buy essential items like pens and folders - prices reduced until Friday. Open daily during lunch breaks. Also for 30 minutes after last class everyday apart from Monday.

options.label: A
options.text: Students must go to the college shop to buy certain items for their studies.

options.label: B
options.text: Students can take advantage of special offers at the college shop at the moment.

options.label: C
options.text: Students may visit the college shop at lunchtime every day except Monday.

questions.explanation:
原文提到 “prices reduced until Friday”（价格降至周五），对应 B 选项 “special offers”（特价优惠）。
A 选项错误，原文仅说 “essential items like pens and folders”（必备物品如笔和文件夹），并未强调 “must go”（必须购买）。
C 选项错误，原文说 “Open daily during lunch breaks”（每天午休开放），“except Monday” 仅针对 “last class 后 30 分钟”，而非午休时间。

questions.text: Hi Max I’m afraid I’ll no longer be able to come on the shopping trip tomorrow. My aunt is visiting and didn't give us much notice. Jake

options.label: A
options.text: suggest a new date for a shopping trip.

options.label: B
options.text: invite Max to meet one of his relatives.

options.label: C
options.text: cancel an arrangement he had made.

questions.explanation:
Jake 说 “I’ll no longer be able to come on the shopping trip tomorrow”（无法参加明天的购物之旅），属于取消约定，对应 C 选项。
A 选项 “suggest a new date”（建议新日期）和 B 选项 “invite Max to meet relatives”（邀请见亲戚）均未提及。

questions.text: Special Offer Order any pizza by 7 p.m. and get another one half-price!

options.label: A
options.text: All the pizzas in the restaurant are included in this offer.

options.label: B
options.text: Any pizza ordered before 7 p.m. costs less than the usual price.

options.label: C
options.text: At certain times, a customer can get two pizzas for the price of one.

questions.explanation:
原文 “Order any pizza by 7 p.m. and get another one half-price”（7 点前点任意披萨，第二份半价），即 “买一送半”，对应 C 选项 “two pizzas for the price of one”（两份披萨的价格相当于一份）。
A 选项 “All pizzas included”（所有披萨都参与）未明确，B 选项 “costs less than usual”（单份比平时便宜）错误，优惠是针对第二份。

questions.text: From: Mr Wood To: All students Subject: Recycling We've done very well with recycling paper and plastic waste in the school this term - but we could do better! Please put any suggestions in the box outside my office.

options.label: A
options.text: Mr Wood has made suggestions on how to recycle waste produced by the school.

options.label: B
options.text: Recycling materials should be put into the box outside Mr Wood's office.

options.label: C
options.text: Mr Wood wants new ideas on ways to improve waste recycling in the school.

questions.explanation:
Mr Wood 说 “we could do better! Please put any suggestions in the box”（我们可以做得更好，请把建议放进盒子），对应 C 选项 “wants new ideas to improve recycling”（想要改进回收的新想法）。
A 选项 “made suggestions”（已提出建议）与原文相反，B 选项 “recycling materials put into box”（回收材料放盒子）错误，盒子是用来放建议的。

questions.text: Hi Sam, Thanks for taking me to the cinema last night. I didn't say at the time but I was a bit frightened! I think I need to watch a comedy next time! Mel

options.label: A
options.text: accept Sam's invitation to the cinema.

options.label: B
options.text: admit to Sam that she found the film scary.

options.label: C
options.text: ask when Sam can see another film with her.

questions.explanation:
Mel 说 “i was a bit frightened”（有点害怕），对应 B 选项 “admit the film was scary”（承认电影可怕）。
A 选项 “accept invitation”（接受邀请）是过去的事，C 选项 “ask when to see another film”（询问下次看电影时间）未提及，仅说 “next time want to watch comedy”（下次想看喜剧）。
